O you who are wrapped up in your clothes.
Stand up and pray in the night, except for a little.
Half of it, or a little less.
Or a little more. And read the Quran slowly and clearly.
We will soon send you a heavy message.
Getting up at night is a strong time for your heart, and a better time to read.
In the day, you have a lot of work to do.
So remember the name of your Lord and give yourself fully to Him.
He is the Lord of the east and the west. There is no god but Him. So trust only Him.
Be patient with what they say, and stay away from them in a polite way.
Leave Me with the people who say it is a lie, the ones who have an easy life. Give them a little time.
With Us are heavy chains and a blazing Fire.
And food that chokes, and a painful punishment.
On the Day when the earth and the mountains shake, and the mountains become like piles of sand.
We sent you a messenger who sees over you, like We sent a messenger to Pharaoh.
But Pharaoh did not obey the messenger, so We took him with a very hard grip.
So how will you protect yourself, if you keep saying no, from a Day that will make children's hair turn gray?
The sky will break apart on that Day. Allah's promise always comes true.
This is a reminder. So whoever wants to, can take a way to his Lord.

Your Lord knows that you stand in prayer nearly two-thirds of the night, or half, or one-third, and so do some of the people with you. Allah sets the night and the day. He knows you cannot keep it up, so He forgave you. So read as much of the Quran as is easy for you. He knows some of you will be sick, some will be traveling to look for Allah's gifts, and some will be fighting for Allah. So read as much as is easy for you. Pray, give charity, and lend Allah a good loan. Whatever good you send ahead, you will find it with Allah, better and with a bigger reward. And ask Allah to forgive you. Allah is Forgiving and Kind.
